metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the best neck exercises to do daily TO KEEP PAIN AWAY!

Here are some easy, effective neck mobility exercises that you can do every single day. Not only
will they focus on quick neck pain relief but they may also help future proof and lessen instances of neck pain, tightness, stiffness, and even HEADACHES.

All of these exercises hit the neck just a little bit differently. Make sure to go through them all, and use what works best for you. 

As a bonus, you can do all of these exercises at home, possibly even at work. They don't require any special equipment and may give quick neck pain relief, even in as little as 30 SECONDS!

Watch now for the best neck exercises to do every morning, day, and night!
